findings.summary: removeComponent captures component.entries before the async confirm dialog and sends removals for those ids afterwards
findings.scenario: If a sceneChanged refresh or selection change lands while the confirm dialog is open, the jobs target stale component ids on objects no longer selected or refresh-changed; the host refuses and the user sees a spurious error (no corruption).

findings.summary: A refusal leaves earlier objects edited (no rollback); roadmap says aborted/rolled back
findings.scenario: 3 objects, 2nd refuses: object 1 stays changed until the user presses Undo; documented in README and dev deviations, so only a product decision to confirm.
